a.xlink:title: Draws the HUD for the current frame.
Draws the bottom info bar (time unit, teams, winner, last log line).
Draws the fixed state panel (below the time box) for the selected entity, if any.
Draws the bottom-left tile panel (resources of the selected tile), if any.
Draws the top-right time-unit box (value and -/+ buttons).
Draws the centered end-of-game banner (big "VICTOIRE" + winning team), if any.
Rectangle of the follow/detach button (bottom row of the state panel).
Bottom edge (in pixels) of the state panel for a selected entity.
Total height of the state panel for a selected entity (lines + buttons).
Rectangle of the view-mode button (second row, shown only while following).
Rectangle of the camera-mode (orbit/free-fly) button, just below the time box.
Rectangle of the "decrease time unit" button.
Rectangle of the "increase time unit" button.
